CustomField.description: Area of the allocated space, derived from the Unit rather than copied. Unit.Square_Feet__c is the single source of truth, so a re-measured suite corrects every square footage allocation that depends on it without a backfill.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pulled from the Unit record, so it cannot be edited here. If it is wrong, correct Square Feet on the Unit and every allocation using it updates.
CustomField.label: Square Feet
